full_text_zh:
[P1] 听昆虫唱歌
撰文/罗玉容 插画/陈昭如

[P2] 听昆虫唱歌
撰文/罗玉容 插画/陈昭如

浙江出版联合集团
浙江少年儿童出版社
2/11

[P3] 夏天的中午，屋外不停地传来“唧唧——唧唧——”的声音，是什么东西在叫呢？

琪琪循着声音传来的方向走到树下，抬头一看，才发现树干上停着一只颜色和树干很相似的昆虫。

[P4] 雄蝉唱的情歌
妈妈说，停在树干上
大叫的昆虫是“蝉”。会
叫的是雄蝉，它们大声叫
是为了吸引雌蝉来结婚。
原来这些我们听起来很吵
的叫声，却是雄蝉对雌蝉
唱的情歌呢！

雄蝉腹部具有鸣器构造，而雌蝉没有，因此雌蝉是不会鸣叫的。

雄蝉和雌蝉结婚的时候，
会以尾端相连，看起来像个浪漫的心形。

[P5] 雄蝉唱歌的方法
蝉的叫声那么大，琪琪想它
一定有张大嘴巴。妈妈却说刚好
相反，蝉的嘴巴又细又长，像吸
管一样，可以用来吸食树汁，却
不能发出声音。蝉的叫声是从肚
子上发出来的！

口器
蝉的口器就是蝉的嘴
巴，好像一根长长的
针，用来刺进树干吸
取美味的树汁。

鸣器
雄蝉的肚子上有个鸣器，雌蝉没有。
当雄蝉高速拉动肌肉时，肚子上的鸣
器会产生共鸣并发出声响。

[P6] 草丛里的蟋蟀声
傍晚，琪琪和妈妈一块儿去散步，忽然从草丛里传出“嚁（qū）——嚁——嚁——”的声音，这也是蝉在唱歌吗？妈妈说那是“蟋蟀”。蟋蟀和蝉一样，只有雄虫才会唱歌，它们唱歌都是为了求婚！

[P7] 蟋蟀摩擦双翅来唱歌
琪琪问妈妈，蟋蟀也是用肚子来唱歌的吗？妈妈说，蟋蟀是通过摩擦两片翅膀来发出声音的，所以蟋蟀叫的时候，翅膀会一开一合地动个不停。
蟋蟀除了求婚时会唱歌，当有其他雄蟋蟀跑到它家附近时，它也会发出警告：“这里是我的家，别靠近，快离开！”
翅膀
蟋蟀的右翅背面有一排齿状物，称为弦器。利用右翅的弦器与左翅的弹器互相摩擦，翅膀就会发出声音。
右翅
弦器
左翅
弹器

[P8] 勇敢唱歌的小昆虫
蝉和蟋蟀都是勇敢的小昆虫，一个在白天唱歌，一个
在晚上唱歌。大声唱歌其实非常危险，因为很可能会被想
要吃它们的鸟类、老鼠和蛙类听到，如果它们一旦被发现，
就很可能被吃掉。

[P9] 迎接小宝宝的歌声
蝉和蟋蟀唱的歌，不只是求婚的歌曲，也是为了迎接小宝宝而唱出的欢乐歌曲。夏天过后，天气转凉时，它们产下的小宝宝就会在土里孵化生长，然后慢慢长大。一年或几年后，等到新的夏天来临，它们又会在树上和草丛里，唱起自己的结婚进行曲。
雌蝉将产卵管插进树干中产卵。
雄蝉大声鸣叫，雌蝉前来交配，也就是蝉儿结婚啦！
若虫最后一次蜕皮被称为羽化，之后长出翅膀变成蝉。
五龄若虫在夏天会从土里爬到地面，等待羽化。
小蝉蚁破卵而出，成为一龄若虫。
若虫每年蜕一次皮，身体越长越大。
蟋蟀将卵产在土壤里。
蟋蟀若虫破卵而出，并钻出地面。若虫的模样和成虫差不多，只是没有翅膀和产卵管。
刚孵出来的若虫，身体还是半透明的。
给爸妈的悄悄话
每种蝉的叫声都不太一样，高砂熊蝉是高低起伏的“唧——唧——唧——唧——”，红脉熊蝉是连续不间断的“叽——”，台湾骚蝉则是响亮又具有节奏的“该该该该——该该该该——”。不妨与孩子一起听听不同种类的蝉叫声，仔细分辨它们的差异。
full_text_en:
[P1] Listening to Insects Sing
Written by Luo Yurong  Illustrated by Chen Zhaoru

[P2] Listening to Insects Sing
Written by Luo Yurong, Illustrated by Chen Zhaoru

Zhejiang Publishing United Group
Zhejiang Children's Publishing House
2/11

[P3] On a summer afternoon, the sound of 'ji-ji—ji-ji—' kept coming from outside the house. What was making that noise?

Qiqi followed the sound to the tree, looked up, and discovered an insect resting on the trunk, its color very similar to the bark.

[P4] The Love Song of the Male Cicada
Mom says, the insect that shouts loudly on the tree trunk is a 'cicada'. The ones that sing are male cicadas, and they call loudly to attract female cicadas to mate. These sounds that we find so noisy are actually love songs sung by male cicadas to female cicadas!

Male cicadas have sound-producing organs in their abdomen, while female cicadas do not, so female cicadas cannot sing.

When male and female cicadas mate, they connect at their tails, looking like a romantic heart shape.

[P5] How Male Cicadas Sing
The cicada's call is so loud, QiQi thought it must have a big mouth. But Mom said just the opposite—cicadas have thin, long mouths, like straws, which they use to suck sap from trees, but cannot make sounds. The cicada's call comes from its belly!

Mouthparts
The cicada's mouthparts are its mouth, like a long needle, used to pierce tree trunks and suck delicious sap.

Sound-producing organ
Male cicadas have a sound-producing organ on their belly; females do not. When the male cicada rapidly pulls its muscles, the organ on its belly produces resonance and makes a sound.

[P6] The Cricket's Song in the Grass
In the evening, QiQi and her mom went for a walk together. Suddenly, a "qū—qū—qū—" sound came from the grass. Was it a cicada singing? Mom said it was a "cricket." Like cicadas, only male crickets sing, and they sing to find a mate!

[P7] Cricket Rubs Its Wings to Sing
Qiqi asks her mom, "Do crickets also sing with their bellies?" Mom says, "Cricket makes sounds by rubbing its two wings together, so when a cricket sings, its wings keep opening and closing.
Cricket sings not only to court, but also when other male crickets come near its home, it will warn: 'This is my home, stay away, leave now!'
Wings
On the back of the right wing of a cricket, there is a row of tooth-like structures called the file. By rubbing the file on the right wing against the scraper on the left wing, the cricket produces sound.
Right Wing
File
Left Wing
Scraper

[P8] Brave Little Singers
Cicadas and crickets are brave little insects, one sings during the day, the other sings at night. Singing loudly is actually very dangerous, because they might be heard by birds, mice, and frogs that want to eat them. If they are discovered, they are very likely to be eaten.

[P9] Welcoming the Baby's Song
The songs of cicadas and crickets are not only love songs, but also joyful songs welcoming their babies. After summer, when the weather turns cool, their babies will hatch and grow in the soil, then slowly grow up. After one or several years, when the new summer comes, they will sing their wedding march again on trees and in grass.
Female cicadas insert their ovipositors into tree trunks to lay eggs.
Male cicadas call loudly, and female cicadas come to mate, which is the cicadas' wedding!
The final molt of the nymph is called emergence, after which wings grow and it becomes an adult cicada.
Fifth-instar nymphs crawl to the surface in summer, waiting for emergence.
Baby cicada hatches from the egg and becomes a first-instar nymph.
Nymphs molt once a year, growing bigger and bigger.
Crickets lay their eggs in the soil.
Crickets' nymphs hatch from eggs and burrow to the surface. Nymphs look similar to adults, but without wings and ovipositors.
Newly hatched nymphs are still translucent.
Tips for Parents
Each type of cicada has a different call. The high-sand bear cicada has a rising and falling "ji---ji---ji---ji---", the red-veined bear cicada has a continuous "ji---", and the Taiwan cicada has a loud and rhythmic "gai gai gai gai---gai gai gai gai---". Try listening to different cicada calls with your child and carefully distinguish their differences.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页是绘本《听昆虫唱歌》的封面，画面中一个小女孩指着树干上的蝉和蝉蜕，背景是绿色的草地和树木，标题和作者信息清晰可见。
[P2] 本页为绘本《听昆虫唱歌》的扉页，显示了书名、作者和插画师信息，以及出版社信息，下方有两只蝉蜕的插图。
[P3] 夏天的中午，小女孩琪琪听到树上传来“唧唧”声，循声找到树下，发现树干上停着一只与树皮颜色相似的昆虫。
[P4] 本页解释了蝉鸣是雄蝉吸引雌蝉的求偶行为，说明雄蝉有鸣器而雌蝉没有，并展示了雄蝉和雌蝉交配时尾部相连的形态，画面中两个小女孩在树下观察蝉。
[P5] 本页解释了雄蝉如何通过腹部的鸣器发出声音，同时介绍了蝉的口器用于吸食树汁，并配有插图展示其结构和小女孩观察的场景。
[P6] 傍晚，小女孩琪琪和妈妈在散步时听到草丛中传来“嚁嚁”的声音，妈妈解释那是蟋蟀在唱歌，并说明只有雄蟋蟀会唱歌，目的是为了求偶。
[P7] 本页解释了蟋蟀通过摩擦左右翅膀发出声音的原理，展示了其翅膀上的弦器和弹器结构，并说明蟋蟀鸣叫不仅用于求偶，也用于警告其他雄蟋蟀远离领地，画面中琪琪和妈妈在观察蟋蟀。
[P8] 本页通过左右两幅插图分别展示了蟋蟀在草丛中鸣叫和蝉在树干上鸣叫的场景，并配文说明蝉和蟋蟀虽然勇敢地唱歌，但此举非常危险，因为它们的声音可能引来鸟类、老鼠和蛙类等天敌，从而被吃掉。
[P9] 本页通过图文并茂的方式，介绍了蝉和蟋蟀的生命周期，包括产卵、若虫在土中生长、蜕皮、羽化等过程，并说明它们的鸣叫不仅是求偶，也是迎接新生命的欢乐歌，同时附有给家长的科普小贴士。
[P10] 画面展示了一只螳螂在树上，树干上有两只刚蜕皮的蝉，旁边还有一只正在飞的蝉，背景是茂密的绿叶。
